messages:
maya: Quick sync for the launch social play  we want a concise X thread (3 nodes) + 1 long LinkedIn post next Tues. Need final copy + hero GIF by Thu noon.

sam: Timeline ok. Recommend we split hooks: technical perf hook + cost-savings hook. Test both as pinned nodes.

lina: Ill draft both hooks and a LinkedIn longform with a short customer quote. Will drop in Drive by Wed AM.

ana: Creative can do a 3-frame GIF + 1 static hero. ETA Thu 11:30. Need the benchmark image and exact stat to call out.

devon: Ill prepare UTMs and the Zapier route: webinar -> sdr-na, case study -> nurture-sales. Proposed utm_campaign=launch-snap-173210, utm_medium=social, utm_source={x|linkedin}, utm_content={tech|cost}.

maya: Posting cadence: NA 10:00 PT (X thread), EU 14:00 CET (X thread variant), APAC 18:00 JST (LinkedIn). Stagger APAC X then LinkedIn 30m later.

sam: Engagement fallback: if <150 interactions in 24h, boost top node $400 and repost alt hook after 12h. ops-bot please add monitor.

ops-bot: Monitor rule created for campaign "launch-snap-173210". Threshold=150 interactions / 24h. Notify @maya @sam @lina on trigger.

lina: Draft link: https://drive.google.com/launch-snap-draft. I added two alt hooks and a compact benchmark image for X.

maya: Final checklist: copy (lina) Wed AM, assets (ana) Thu 11:30, UTM & Zap (devon) Thu EOD, queue Fri morning. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
